question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes various** pieces of jewelry being worn by Queen Gulnaar of Arabia.**
 
• **"Wrist"** is the most appropriate option as it fits the context of bangles being worn above the elbow and on the wrist.
 
• Other options like **"toe", "waist", and "ankle" do not fit the description**, as bangles are typically worn on the wrist or arm.
 
• The correct word for fill in blanks no. 3 is **'****wrist.'**
 
• Therefore the correct statement from the passage is **"....... a few bangles above the elbow and wrist__ on the right hands display an almost modern art."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Toe"** does not fit because bangles are worn on the arm, not on the toes.
 
• **"Waist"** does not fit because bangles are not typically worn around the waist.
 
• **"Ankle"** does not fit because bangles are worn on the wrist or arm, not on the ankles.
